\begin{abstract}
A short note on the tides of the fictitious port of Saltmere, for visiting skippers.
\end{abstract}

\section{Spring tides}
Spring tides reach $h = 5.2$ metres two days after the full moon~\cite{castell2023}.
High water at the outer mole comes about forty minutes after high water at the bar.

\section{Neap tides}
Neap tides rise to 3.9 metres; berth 3 still dries at low water.
